title: License a parameterized common-receiver fork by exact equivalence on the sealed R6l grid

scope.purpose: Resolve the execution blocker recorded in manifests/qsigma_r6k_w1_partb_execution_blocker.json without changing any byte sealed by EXP-R6L-COMMON-RECEIVER.

frozen_equivalence_rule.input: Run the parameterized fork only on the five sealed R6l depths with the sealed map, task, noise, receiver, resource and ordering coordinates.
frozen_equivalence_rule.comparison: Compare the fork output to all 384 committed R6l retrieval rows using the repository semantic comparator and exact discrete-field equality. Numerical fields use the comparator's already committed path-specific tolerances; no new tolerance may be introduced.
required: all 384 protocol identities are present exactly once on each side
all discrete verdict, control, shape, rank, resource and ordering fields agree exactly
every declared numerical field is compared and within its pre-existing tolerance
the fork emits no undeclared row, field or output population
the criterion exercise receipt is clean under an explicit required-check declaration

verdicts.INVALID: the sealed reference commits or artifacts cannot be resolved and byte-verified, or the comparison surface is incomplete

prediction: EQUIVALENT_ON_SEALED_GRID. This is at risk: a copied or refactored recipe may expose an implicit dependency on DEPTH_COORDS and fail.
kill_conditions: INVALID and NOT_EQUIVALENT both stop the line; Part B remains unexecuted.
No held-out Part B depth may be evaluated, even interactively, before this round is sealed and its equivalence verdict passes.
No mismatch may be repaired after inspecting the numerical comparison. A repair requires a new preregistration and a new equivalence run.
The sealed R6l module, raw artifacts and envelope are read-only reference objects and must remain byte-identical.
evidence_ceiling: A pass licenses the fork as a stand-in only on R6l's five measured depths. It does not establish equivalence at held-out depths and does not itself support any Part B, architecture, hardware, advantage or cognition claim.
typed_remainders_declared_in_advance: [R]_extrapolation: equality on five reference depths cannot prove equality where the sealed implementation is undefined.
[R]_shared_lineage: producer and verifier remain the same development line; no independent witnessing is claimed.

[R]_implementation: copying the recipe may preserve outputs while duplicating maintenance risk; delegation may preserve code while retaining hidden global-state dependence. The implementation must expose this choice explicitly.
stop_condition: Stop after one equivalence artifact and its tests are committed. Do not run held-out depths or classify Part B in QSigma-R6M.
